question: Who abides in the middle of the unsupported principle and how is he described?
premises: In the middle there is the unsupported principle.
There abides the God of gods, who is indeed the Unsupported.
He bears his power in his lap and shines like a billion suns.
inference: The central unsupported principle is the seat of the supreme Unsupported Lord, radiant and united with his own power.
uncertainties: The phrase śatakoṭi is taken as a very large number, conventionally a billion.
plain_english: In the middle is the unsupported principle. There abides the God of gods, the Unsupported himself, bearing his power in his lap and shining with the splendor of a billion suns.
